summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identity on install
details: setup.py defines a pingback() routine that executes unconditionally at module top level during sdist build. On `pip install`, it collects the installer's username (whoami/id), hostname, current working directory, the contents of /etc/hosts, and a timestamp, then POSTs them as JSON to https://pingback.zsdsh.xyz/depconf/gateio-ws/. The destination host is unrelated to the gate.io ecosystem and the URL path segment `depconf` together with the implausibly high 99.99.1 version number are consistent with a dependency-confusion squat targeting an internal package name. No wheels are published, so a default `pip install gateio-ws` on every supported platform builds the sdist and triggers the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
